title: Mallworld is not a psychic realm you visit when you sleep.
content: It’s like flying dreams, or dreams where you’re running slowly and trying to escape a monster, or the very common “teeth falling out” nightmare that’s popular all over the world. It’s just a common style of dream. It’s a side effect of how our brains process information while we sleep. I read a post where the OP asked “why am I seeing my toxic ex in Mallworld?” It’s because *you’re still hurting from that bad experience and your brain is still trying to process it in your dreams*. it’s not your actual ex waiting for you in a psychic plane. I joined this sub because I thought it was interesting that others were having similar dreams, and I enjoyed how people were illustrating them, not because I think it’s all a conspiracy. Edit: just to add to this, I’ve had “Mallworld” dreams my entire life, for as long as I can remember. They are vivid, an I often revisit the same places over and over. Would it be cool if it *was* an actual place my consciousness visits at night?? Absolutely! But it’s just not. If it were a real place, scientists and physicians and sleep experts would’ve discovered it and proven it long ago. Edit 2: well, it’s been fun y’all. Unfortunately, this sub ain’t for me anymore. I was astounded when I found an entire community dedicated to the same type of weird dreams I’ve had my entire life (I’ve called them “wandering dreams” since childhood, personally). But unfortunately, I just can’t agree with a lot of the discussion happening in this sub anymore. I don’t believe that the Mallworld is a place we psychically travel to when we sleep, and I highly doubt anyone will ever be able to convince me otherwise. That being said, I doubt I will be able to convince those of you who do believe in the Mallworlds lore otherwise as well. I’m not expert on sleep or dreams or the human brain, I mainly operate off my gut, much like many of you are doing as well. This discussion doesn’t feel very productive: people on this sub will believe what they believe. I just wanted to let y’all know how I feel, which I did. My parting thoughts: try to stay skeptical, try to figure this whole mystery out through reasonable and grounded means. Don’t just jump feet first into a fantasy because it’s fun. Bye bye!! Maybe I’ll see you in the Mallworld. (But actually, if there’s an angry mob waiting for me in my dreams tonight, I’ll know the truth 🫢) Edit 3: look. I clearly am not gonna change some of y’all minds, and you’re not gonna change mine. Say as much as you want that I’m not having “real” Mallworld dreams. It just tells me you really need this to be real for some reason. This thread is getting exhausting and I’ve said everything I want to say. If it makes you mad, I’d really like you to lean into *why that is*. I’m turning off notifications for this post. And some of y’all will say it’s because I can’t take the heat. And I promise you, from the bottom of my heart, that’s not true. It’s because *I have to go to work and this conversation is not productive anymore.* Goodbye!
